correctness.rationale: The polar mean weights are m_j=lambda*w_j+(1-lambda)*w_{j+1}; periodic powers T^n=(product w_j)U^n give r(T)=(product w_j)^{1/n} also for unilateral/bilateral shifts. Weighted geometric-AM inequality telescopes under multiplication for the lower ratio 1, with equality iff all weights equal for interior parameters. In logarithmic coordinates log w_j∈[0,log K], the log product is strictly convex in each coordinate for 0<lambda<1, forcing all upper maximizers to binary endpoint weights. Every a->Ka change pairs a reverse change; transition count 2k<=2floor(n/2), and exact product is Theta^k. This proves sharp extremizers and the odd-period single equal edge. Maximization in lambda of lambda(1-lambda) yields its unique midpoint in nondegenerate cases. Independent exact-rational enumeration verified transition formula and all binary maxima across 81 (n,lambda,K) families n=2..10; the proof, not finite enumeration, establishes all dimensions/real parameters.
